headline: Stlican Shelf Weathered Expanse Lead Frontline Clashes
war_summary: Since the 12:11 edition the fighting has sharpened on a handful of sectors. Stlican Shelf now records ten ownership changes in the last two hours and sixty in the past day, with colonial and warden casualties both accelerating (≈80 and 38 per hour) and enlistments climbing sharply. Weathered Expanse follows with four recent flips and fifty‑nine daily; casualties on both sides are surging (≈873 and 1 057 per hour) while fresh enlistments rise. Callahan’s Passage has added four flips in the last six hours and eighteen overall; casualties remain massive and are accelerating (≈920 and 631 per hour) with enlistments surging. Dead Lands has gone quiet in the last two hours but still logged sixteen daily flips; colonial losses are accelerating (≈7 per hour) while warden losses dip, and enlistments are flat. Stonecradle shows three new flips in two hours and twelve daily, with both casualty streams accelerating (≈422 and 495 per hour) and enlistments rising. Linn Mercy reports twelve daily events, no fresh flips, and cooling casualties on both windows, though enlistments are picking up. The remaining regions remain largely static, with negligible events and low, stable casualties.
